    StartersCarnaby Street devilled eggs with baconHalved boiled eggs filled with creamy yolk mayo and crisp baconHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp white vinegar3 rashers of bacon1 tsp smoked paprika1 small bunch chivessalt, to tasteLower the eggs into boiling water and cook, then cool in iced water and peel.Halve the eggs and scoop out the yolks. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth.Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble finely.Spoon the yolk mix back into the whites, dust with paprika and top with bacon and chives.Sixties cheese and pineapple hedgehogCheddar, pineapple, cabana and onion on picks stuck in a rockmelonHow to make it1/2 rockmelon2 cloves250g vintage cheddar1/2 pineapple150g cabana1 jar cocktail onions1 box toothpicksCut the rockmelon into pieces and place one piece cut-side down on a platter as the body, with cloves for eyes.Cut the cheddar and pineapple into cubes and slice the cabana into rounds.Thread toothpicks with cheese, pineapple and either a cocktail onion or cabana.Push them all over the rockmelon until covered in spikes.MainsDr Evil's volcano lair steak DianeSirloin in mushroom, brandy and cream sauce, fries and watercressHow to make it1kg frozen shoestring fries4 sirloin steaks1 tbsp vegetable oil30g butter200g button mushrooms, sliced1 shallot, diced40ml brandy1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 tsp Dijon mustard150ml thickened cream1 bunch watercressBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Bat out the steaks to about 1cm thick, season and sear in the vegetable oil in a very hot pan, then rest on a plate.In the same pan melt the butter and fry the mushrooms and shallot.Add the brandy and let it bubble off, then add the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer.Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve with the fries and watercress.SweetsUnion Jack berry trifleJam sponge, sherry, raspberries, custard, cream and strawberry flag topHow to make it300g jam rollette60ml sweet sherry200g raspberries600ml thick vanilla custard300ml thickened cream1 tbsp icing sugar250g strawberries, halved125g blueberriesSlice the jam rollette and line a large glass bowl. Drizzle with the sherry.Scatter over the raspberries and pour over the custard.Chill until the custard firms up.Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft peaks and spread over the top.Lay strawberries in a cross and diagonals, then fill the gaps with blueberries to make a Union Jack.DrinksAustin's gin martiniGin and dry vermouth stirred over ice, with an oliveHow to make it240ml gin40ml dry vermouth1 lemon1 jar green olives1 bag iceChill the martini glasses in the freezer.Fill a jug with ice, add the gin and vermouth and stir steadily until very cold.Strain into the glasses. Twist a strip of lemon zest over each, or add an olive on a pick.Harvey WallbangerShagadelic, says Austin, unfrozen since 1967.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
